name: agent-vscode
description: Drive a agent session from the VS Code Agents window, over the gateway's HTTP/SSE edge.

chatSessions.name: agent
chatSessions.description: A agent session, streamed live from the gateway.

agent.gatewayUrl.description: Base URL of the agent gateway (http(s)://host:port).

agent.token.markdownDescription: Bearer token sent to the gateway. In the loopback dev gateway (`demo-agent.sh`) the token IS the tenant, so any value names a fresh tenant. Prefer the `Agent: Set Gateway Token` command, which stores the token in VS Code SecretStorage instead of settings.

agent.kind.description: Session kind (entity type) to list and address, e.g. "assistant".

agent.withinSecs.description: Per-prompt wait ceiling in seconds sent as within_secs; the gateway clamps it to its own maximum.
